meta.title: RFQ bid: Two users of the same vendor company bid
gaps: Open the event as a second user from the same vendor company in a separate vendor session
Assert the second submission is refused with the message "A bid has already been placed from your team" or is recorded as a revision of the existing company bid
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open the event as a second user from the same vendor company in a separate vendor session; Assert the second submission is refused with the message "A bid has already been placed from your team" or is recorded as a revision of the existing company bid

steps.note: Start a new multi-stage event create flow.
Configure the event as an RFQ-only event.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add one product for the bid sheet.
Invite the QA vendor company that will submit the bids.
Publish the RFQ so the vendor can bid.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Submit the first bid as Vendor A's first user.
Confirm the first vendor bid was accepted.

args.need: sign in as a second user from the same vendor company in a separate vendor session, open this live RFQ, submit a bid of 98, and report whether it was refused with the team-already-bid message or recorded as a revision

steps.note: A second user session for the same vendor company and its refusal-or-revision outcome are not available to catalog steps.
Verify the buyer still sees exactly one direct vendor response after the second-user attempt.
